reviewNotes: Inspected full rowing boat, sailboat and canoe, coherent hulls, oars and rigging; complete subjects with margins.
prompt: Use case: photorealistic preschool vocabulary teaching boats. ONE triptych comprising exactly THREE equal-height horizontal landscape photos stacked vertically, edge to edge with boundaries at one third and two thirds. TOP: one full-size wooden rowing boat floating beside a quiet lake shore, entire hull and real wooden oars clearly visible. MIDDLE: one full-size small sailboat on calm water, entire hull, upright mast, coherent rigging and complete triangular white sail in frame. BOTTOM: one full-size narrow open canoe floating near shore, whole hull with seats and a real paddle visible. Boats must be structurally sound practical watercraft at believable scale, correctly supported by water with reflections. Generous margins, natural daylight, wood grain and fabric weave, real camera detail. No people, toy boats, miniatures, cartoon, vector illustration, CGI, writing, logos, captions, borders, gutters or watermark.
